listing.fhsz: verify on CAL FIRE map — oak woodland WUI, Twin Oaks/Caliente, Kern County (presumptive High/Very High)
listing.style: 1986 off-grid rustic cabin/homestead; knotty-pine interior, wood stove, metal roof, solar + lithium battery system, well + septic
listing.description: Off-grid fixer-upper on 20 acres in the desirable Twin Oaks area of Caliente! Located just off the paved road for easy access, this private property offers great potential for a vacation getaway, hunting retreat, or homestead. The home features dual-pane windows, French doors leading to a concrete patio with beautiful mountain views, and room for animals, gardening, or possibly an additional home. Off-grid amenities include 11 solar panels, Renogy inverter, 8 new lithium batteries with battery banks, private water well, and septic system. Enjoy privacy, mountain views, and endless possibilities. Cash only.

view.note: Real living-level views: French doors + covered patio face oak-dotted valley and ridge lines (p_02, p_08, p_10); valley-bowl scale, not a sweeping panorama; drone shots p_01/p_16 corroborate

lot_nature.note: 20.39 ac of genuine oak woodland + grass clearings (p_16, p_17), gentle usable pasture with barn + corrals (p_15), flag-topped hill, paved-road frontage (parcel overlay p_18) — a real piece of land

turnkey_airbnb.note: Marketed as fixer-upper, cash only; furnished but rough (exposed OSB bedroom ceiling p_04); no rental history; off-grid systems are STR-independent but condition gates everything; verify Kern County STR permit rules

price_accessibility.note: $175,000 — top band (≤$350k); $331/sf on 528 sqft with 20 acres included

condition.note: Fixer: metal roof patched/peeling (p_11), exposed OSB ceiling (p_04), DIY finishes throughout; offset by strong systems — 11 solar panels + Renogy inverter + 8 new lithium batteries, private well, septic, dual-pane windows (marketing, unverified in photos except arrays p_11/p_13)

natural_light.note: Skylight + French doors + big kitchen windows (p_02, p_07) — bright for a cabin; bedroom zone dimmer (p_04)

character.note: Knotty pine + wood stove on stone accent wall (p_03), barnwood headboard wall (p_04), surfboard porch ceiling (p_09), cowboy-homestead vibe — quirky charm in spades

verdict: A $175k off-grid homestead on 20 genuinely beautiful oak-woodland acres with its own solar/lithium power plant, well, septic, barn and corrals — the best land-per-dollar yet seen in this bucket, and the marketing is honest that it's a cash-only fixer. But it's 6.7 hours from SF, hard-failing the 3h getaway gate, and the structure needs real work (roof, ceilings, finishes). For an SF buyer this is a homesteading project a long way from home, not a weekend cabin — score it, flag it, and only revisit if the radius rule changes.
